tzx-touch.service:
[Unit]
ConditionKernelVersion=
ConditionKernelVersion=7.3.3-tzx-a523-accel1
[Service]
ExecStart=
ExecStart=/bin/sh /usr/local/lib/tzx-peripherals-accel1/tzx-touch-runtime-test.sh start
ExecStop=
ExecStop=/bin/sh /usr/local/lib/tzx-peripherals-accel1/tzx-touch-runtime-test.sh stop
tzx-wifi.service:
[Unit]
ConditionKernelVersion=
ConditionKernelVersion=7.3.3-tzx-a523-accel1
[Service]
ExecStart=
ExecStart=/bin/sh /usr/local/lib/tzx-peripherals-accel1/tzx-wifi-runtime start

tzx-display.service:

[Service]

ExecStart=/bin/sh /usr/local/lib/tzx-accel-display/tzx-display-runtime start

[Unit]

tzx-battery.service:
[Unit]
ConditionKernelVersion=
ConditionKernelVersion=7.3.3-tzx-a523-accel1
[Service]
ExecStart=
ExecStart=/sbin/modprobe tzx_battery
ExecStop=
ExecStop=/sbin/modprobe -r tzx_battery
